sloka: एक पुत्रा च साध्वी च विवत्सा इयम् त्वया कृता ।तस्मात् त्वम् सततम् दुह्खम् प्रेत्य च इह च लप्स्यसे ॥२-७४-२९॥
transliteration: eka putrā ca sādhvī ca vivatsā iyam tvayā kṛtā ।tasmāt tvam satatam duhkham pretya ca iha ca lapsyase ॥2-74-29॥

translations.english: This pious lady is blessed with only one son and (now) has been rendered childless by you. Therefore, you shall experience grief in this world and hereafter.
